world.extent_policy: All new landmark bounds come from world.json. No resize data or invented valley landmarks committed.

places.lookup: Exact casefold match on name or aliases; return all stable-ID-sorted matches; no match returns known display names.
places.approval: set_last_known_place requires a quoted briefing span naming the place or alias and an explicit map approval in every autonomy mode. Decline/cancellation preserves the hypothesis; approval revalidates geometry and invalidates the saved plan.

line_prior.assumption: Unknown position uniform along approved arclength; no behaviour weighting in Stage 1.
line_prior.formula: m_i = A_i * sum_j(w_j * mean_q rho(||x_iq - s_j||^2)); w_j = segment_length/(sample_count * total_length); M = sum_i m_i; p_i = m_i/M.
line_prior.normalization: Weights sum to one. Average unconditioned radial cell masses before world conditioning; retained mass is M. Existing single-point prior is the one-support case.
line_prior.quadrature: Midpoints of segments divided so each interval is no longer than the shortest grid-cell side. The line midpoint is a map anchor only.

places.directions: Horizontal exact nearest point/segment/polygon distance; compass direction of feature-to-location displacement and side of nearest polyline. Open endpoints identified separately. Creek banks are geometric compass sides, not downstream left/right. No walkable route is inferred.
places.hero_profile: Age 74 in the exact father-comma-age-comma quotation is supported; time, duration and separate quotation fragments do not supply age.

headline.region_rule: Sum the whole probability of every positive-area grid cell intersecting the closed 95% location ellipse; includes tangency.
headline.measurement_scope: Current intersection code applied to the accepted recorded localization and grid; probabilities are read from the preserved first-positive audit, not re-estimated or re-inferred.

place_cases.request: Resolve the named place 'FOOTBRIDGE' using the landmark catalogue.
Look up the exact alias 'crossing'. It may name more than one place; show all matching candidates.
Look up 'Unlisted Saddle' exactly. If unknown, show the known names.
Give landmark directions for the point 38 metres north and 12 metres west of mission origin.
The find_place result for 'crossing' returned two candidates: bridge-a, North Bridge; bridge-b, South Bridge. Ask me which one I mean before proposing a last known location. No new lookup is needed.

The find_place result for 'Unlisted Saddle' has no matches and known_names ['North Bridge', 'Creek Loop']. Present those names and ask me to choose or mark the map; keep this response to that clarification.
